title: Spicy Jalapeño Cheeseburgers
changes_from_base: Smashed thin with diced onion pressed into the top and onion fried alongside, then finished with American cheese, pickles and a layer of fresh jalapeño slices on butter-toasted buns.
summary: Smashed tissue-thin beef fuses instantly with melted cheese and caramelised onion, sparked by bright pickles and jalapeño heat.

ingredients.item: beef mince (about 20% fat), loosely rolled into 2 balls
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Melt 15 g butter in one large frying pan over low and wipe the cut sides of 2 burger buns through it, toasting for about 5 min until golden and warm.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Heat a stainless steel pan over medium-high until a flick of water beads and vanishes at once; add 225 g beef mince loosely rolled into 2 balls well apart, smash as thin as possible with the base of a heavy saucepan and hold for 10 s.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Scatter half of 50 g finely diced onion on the beef and half in the empty part of the pan, season with ½ tsp fine salt and ¼ tsp ground black pepper, cook about 1 min until browned, scrape under the edges with a thin flat spatula, flip, lay 2 slices of American-style processed cheese on and cook 1-2 min until the cheese melts and the patties reach 71 °C, stirring the loose onion.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread 2 tbsp mayonnaise on both bun halves, place 4 dill pickle slices on the bases, top with the patties, the fried onion and a layer of 1 small thinly sliced jalapeño.

tips: Open windows and turn on the extractor as this creates a lot of smoke.
Smash beef immediately it hits the hot pan to maximise browning.
Keep pickles and jalapeños separate until assembly to stay crisp.
storage: These are best eaten immediately whilst the cheese is melted and the buns are warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
